children: Mercury Systems received preliminary court approval for a proposed settlement of stockholder derivative actions that includes corporate governance reforms and a $600,000 fee agreement for stockholders' counsel.
Court granted preliminary approval (Sept 9 & 15, 2026) of settlement to resolve Jones and McKinnon derivative actions.
Settlement requires board to adopt specified governance reforms within 45 days, effective for at least four years.
Mercury agreed to pay $600,000 to stockholders’ counsel for fees and expenses, subject to court approval.
Reforms include quarterly independent director executive sessions, annual board governance training, and strengthened internal audit and disclosure committees.
Settlement hearing scheduled for Nov 19, 2026 to consider final approval and fee application; notice provided to shareholders of record as of Sept 15, 2026.

title: Mercury Systems wins preliminary court approval for derivative settlement, agrees governance reforms
